engineeringLimitations: The existing visible0.5m support spacing remains a replaceable planning assumption; the number is not a new manufacturer norm.
No automatic locations of fixed and sliding supports or compensation loops are invented.
Anchor capacity depends on substrate class, thickness, edge distances, loads and installation temperature. The catalogue product match is not project verification.
Unknown/hollow/metal/wet bases and stand-off through finish do not acquire this fastener set by default.
FKS box100 and STS bag4 are separate supplies. The three fastener components are included in the STS price and must not be bought or paid again.
Historic generic support-package orders/prices have no automatic unit or price equivalence to these new rows.
